name: Exp_T3_TRIX
summary: This EA trades based on the T3_TRIX custom indicator, which is a triple-smoothed rate-of-change oscillator. It supports three entry modes: histogram zero-line breakout, histogram direction reversal, and signal cloud color change. Positions are opened and closed based on these momentum signals with configurable lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于T3_TRIX自定义指标进行交易，该指标是一个三重平滑的变动率振荡器。它支持三种入场模式：直方图零线突破、直方图方向反转和信号云颜色变化。根据这些动量信号开仓和平仓，并支持可配置的手数大小和止损/止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于T3_TRIX指标，这是一个结合了T3平滑算法的三重指数移动平均变动率指标。策略概念是通过多重平滑过滤噪音，捕捉价格动量变化。入场条件有三种模式：breakdown模式在直方图穿越零线时入场，twist模式在直方图方向改变时入场，cloudtwist模式在信号云颜色变化时入场。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓或止损止盈，多头平仓由BUY_Close信号触发，空头平仓由SELL_Close信号触发。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理使用MMMode参数选择手数计算方法，默认为LOT模式。止损和止盈分别默认为1000点和2000点，提供了基本的风险控制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the T3_TRIX indicator, which is a triple exponentially smoothed rate-of-change oscillator combined with the T3 smoothing algorithm. The strategy concept filters market noise through multiple smoothing passes to capture genuine momentum shifts. Entry conditions support three modes: breakdown mode enters when the histogram crosses the zero line, twist mode enters when the histogram direction reverses, and cloudtwist mode enters when the signal cloud changes color. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals triggering position closure or stop-loss/take-profit levels, with long positions closed by BUY_Close signals and short positions closed by SELL_Close signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-share-based lot calculation. Money management uses the MMMode parameter to select the lot calculation method, defaulting to LOT mode. Stop-loss and take-profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing basic risk control.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 交易份额或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit ratio or fixed lot; negative = lots

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法模式：零线突破/方向反转/云颜色变化
parameters.description_en: Entry mode: level breakout / direction change / cloud color change

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号

pros: 三种灵活的入场模式适应不同市场状态，交易者可根据偏好选择
使用T3多重平滑算法有效过滤市场噪音，减少虚假信号
具备完整的止损止盈机制和滑点控制，风险管理基础完善
支持多空双向交易并可独立控制开平仓权限，灵活性高
新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易，减少过度交易
pros_en: Three flexible entry modes adapt to different market conditions, allowing traders to choose based on preference
T3 multiple smoothing algorithm effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Complete stop-loss/take-profit mechanism with slippage control provides solid risk management foundation
Supports bidirectional trading with independent control over long/short open and close permissions
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar, reducing overtrading
cons: 依赖外部自定义指标T3_TRIX和两个包含文件，独立性和可移植性差
缺少止损止盈的动态调整机制（如追踪止损），盈利保护能力不足
没有点差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在高成本时段交易
单一指标策略缺乏多因子确认，在震荡市中容易产生虚假信号
SignalBar默认为1意味着使用已收盘K线信号，但入场延迟可能错过最佳价格
cons_en: Depends on external custom indicator T3_TRIX and two include files, reducing independence and portability
Lacks dynamic stop-loss/take-profit adjustment (e.g., trailing stop), limiting profit protection capability
No spread filter or trading session filter, may trade during high-cost periods
Single-indicator strategy lacks multi-factor confirmation, prone to false signals in ranging markets
SignalBar default of 1 means using closed bar signals, but entry delay may miss optimal price levels
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高成本时段开仓
添加追踪止损功能以动态保护盈利，提高盈亏比
增加多时间周期确认机制，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions during high-cost periods
Add trailing stop functionality to dynamically protect profits and improve risk-reward ratio
Add multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 单一指标依赖风险，T3_TRIX在震荡市中可能频繁发出虚假信号导致连续亏损
没有点差过滤，在高点差时段交易可能显著侵蚀利润
止损1000点和止盈2000点固定设置可能不适合所有市场波动环境
risk_points_en: Single indicator dependency risk - T3_TRIX may generate frequent false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses
No spread filter - trading during high-spread periods can significantly erode profits
Fixed 1000-point SL and 2000-point TP settings may not suit all market volatility environments
